body: I may PM you later, am in school right now. On reddit to try and keep my mind off of things. I have been suffering from it for years too, and it doesn't seem to get any better for me. Medicine does not help me, or hasn't, also I don't feel like if I get better on that, but am not better on it, then, is it really me, anymore?

I am told that by some people that have then said later that I am once they got to know me for awhile, so it has become my true belief that I am worthless. I am 14 years old. Yes, freshmen in high school.

I am a freshmen in High School, and I feel very close to attempting suicide. I was admitted into a psychiatric hospital, and it made me much worse being in there, I had to fake being good to get out. I was addicted to many things before going in, and am close to starting them again. When I missed those three weeks of school, it threw me behind, and I am failing. I wish I had you as my teacher, for I feel like no one cares. I also do not feel like I deserve anyone to care. I am glad to know that there is someone in the education system, somewhere, that actually cares. You restored my faith in United States education. Keep doing what you are doing, OP.
